title: Are Stablecoins Changing Crypto? | Fidelity Investments
description:
Stablecoins are shaping the future of cryptocurrency – and global payments. In this episode of the Covering Crypto Livestream, Fidelity pros break down what stablecoins are, how stablecoins work, and why they’re becoming a critical part of the digital asset ecosystem. Learn how stablecoins are used for crypto trading, blockchain-based payments, and cross border transactions. Also, hear from the Fidelity team about regulations, adoption, and the recent launch of the Fidelity Digital DollarSM. Whether you’re new to stablecoins or looking to understand their role in crypto markets, this conversation covers the fundamentals investors should know.
